steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: Understand project requirements, identify technical challenges, and define the engineering objectives.

steps.title: Engineering & Design
steps.text: Develop the architecture, design circuits, select components, and create PCB layouts.

steps.title: Development & Testing
steps.text: Develop hardware and firmware, integrate components, and perform functional testing.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: Deliver agreed engineering files, documentation, prototypes, and final project results.
